name: Selfish
source:
As a child, Kamilla was sold by her family to House Bathos, one of the courtesan houses within the Palace of Evain. Under the guidance of the head of the house, Lady Bathos, she was trained in all the artistic and social skills a courtesan is expected to wield. Now as one of the most successful palace courtesans, Kamilla lives her days peacefully.

But the king is dying and the lords and ladies are in an uproar. Rumour and scandal run rife within the palace walls, and the threat of war from neighbouring kingdoms has everyone on edge. Within House Bathos, however, trivial concerns seem much more prevalent, as the courtesans scramble to be the top-earners and pay their way to freedom.

And Kamilla has her own problems, not only within her house, but also at the hands of the palace staff, and even from royalty.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=42077]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
卡米拉小时候被家人卖给巴托斯家族，这是伊万宫内的妓院之一。在女主人巴托斯夫人的指导下，她接受了交际花应具备的所有艺术和社交技能的培训。现在，作为最成功的宫廷妓女之一，卡米拉过着平静的日子。

但国王已死，诸侯贵妇们一片哗然。宫墙内谣言和丑闻盛行，邻国的战争威胁让每个人都紧张不安。然而，在巴托斯家族中，琐碎的担忧似乎更加普遍，因为妓女们争先恐后地成为收入最高的人，并为自由付出代价。

卡米拉也有她自己的问题，不仅在她的家里，而且还来自王宫工作人员，甚至来自皇室。
